Done. All 286 tests pass.

I implemented the city-capacity rejection in `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`:

- Added a `hasReachedCityCapacity(String city)` check in the create flow (`OwnerRestControllerV1.java:114`) that returns `400 Bad Request` when the city already contains 8 owners.
- The helper (`MAX_OWNERS_PER_CITY = 8`) counts existing owners whose city matches ignoring case — consistent with the case-insensitive city handling already used by `generateCustomerCode` and `normalizeCity`. A null city is treated as never at capacity.

The check runs against the raw incoming city (before canonical-casing normalization), so it works regardless of spelling/case variations.

Done. All 286 tests pass.

I implemented the city-capacity rejection in `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`:

- Added a `hasReachedCityCapacity(String city)` check in the create flow (`OwnerRestControllerV1.java:114`) that returns `400 Bad Request` when the city already contains 8 owners.
- The helper (`MAX_OWNERS_PER_CITY = 8`) counts existing owners whose city matches ignoring case — consistent with the case-insensitive city handling already used by `generateCustomerCode` and `normalizeCity`. A null city is treated as never at capacity.

The check runs against the raw incoming city (before canonical-casing normalization), so it works regardless of spelling/case variations.
